bagPolicy.summary: The indoor Observatory visit and accessibility pages do not publish a general bag size or clear-bag rule for indoor concerts. The separate Festival Grounds policy applies to outdoor shows.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Parking is signed near the venue at West Lake Center Drive and South Harbor Boulevard. Pre-purchase is encouraged; remaining spaces are very limited and filled first come, first served.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The indoor Observatory visit page does not publish a designated rideshare pickup or drop-off area.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The indoor venue offers food and drinks on its patio and optional food-and-beverage packages in the balcony. The Fast Lane patio opens one hour before doors for select shows; general admission guests can use it once doors open.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The main room has an accessible entry ramp, an ADA section and accessible restrooms near the stage. Request a sign-language interpreter at least two weeks before the show.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Staff can assist a guest with a service animal to leave and re-enter for an animal relief break. The indoor venue does not publish a general re-entry rule for other guests.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The venue says its box office opens on show days about one hour before doors, but does not publish a separate will-call pickup procedure.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The indoor Observatory entrance is at the front of the building; an accessible ramp leads into the main room. Check the individual show for its door time.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
